poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE HEARTBEAT ACCELERATES BEYOND CONTROL'S GRIP.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A QUIET SHOCK WASHES OVER YEARS OF GUARDED SILENCE.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS UNEXPECTED BLOOM REQUIRES ALL MY FAITH.
sonnetLines: The walls I built were strong and high,
A fortress against the passing sky.
I swore my heart was made of stone,
Content to walk this path alone.
But sunlight found a hidden seam,
A simple glance, a whispered name,
My careful walls began to bend,
Where fear and sweet desire blend.
I didn't know the depth of grace,
Or how to hold this fragile space.
Just caught within the golden light,

lyrics.text: I've rejected affection
For years and years
Now I have it and damn it
It's kind of weird
He tells me I'm pretty
Don't know how to respond
I tell him that he's pretty too
Can I say that? Don't have a clue
With every passing moment
I surprise myself
I'm scared of flies
I'm scared of guys
Someone please help
'Cause I think I've fallen
In love this time
I blinked and suddenly I had a valentine (be my valentine)
What if he's the last one I kiss?
What if he's the only one I'll ever miss?
Maybe I should run, I'm only twenty-one
I don't even know who I want to become
I've lost all control of my heartbeat now
Got caught in a romance with him somehow
I still feel a shock through every bone
When I hear an, "I love you"
'Cause now I've got someone to lose
The first one to ever like me back
I'm seconds away from a heart attack
How the hell did I fall in love this time?
And honestly, I can't believe I get to call you mine
I blinked and suddenly
I had a valentine
Valentine
